capabilities: create posts in dated folders from a server-downloaded frontmatter template
lint frontmatter against the live server schema before publishing
publish posts and upload folder assets, rewriting wiki-links and cross-post links
pull and sync published posts and metadata between vault and server
generate covers and suggest excerpts, tags, and alt text with AI
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer for secret storage; the API token lives in secret storage, not the vault. The plugin only talks to the production Valeon backend and only recognises posts in YYYY-MM-DD-{slug}/post.md folder layout. Also covers conflict handling with automatic local backups.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to the Valeon blogging platform or keep local post files matched with their remote counterparts.

relations.evidence: Install Victor Tao's Linter plugin (community plugin id obsidian-linter) and enable Lint on save.
translates either form into a stable valeon:post:{id} URI before sending the body to Convex

requires.name: Valeon API token stored in Obsidian secret storage

summary: Publishing client that creates, lints, publishes, and syncs posts with the Valeon author dashboard, handling assets, links, and AI helpers.
